text: AC14 requires no real credential in any evidence or fixture, but the planned executable scan is limited to the benchmark tree while the new evidence documents are under docs/testing/ronda/. Extend the test/verification targets to include those committed evidence artifacts and campaign outputs.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 58d4cfd, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head.
